{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"4th Impact (formerly known as The Cercado Sisters, The Cercados, The Gollayan Sisters, MICA, and 4th Power) is a Filipino girl group composed of sisters Almira, Irene, Mylene, and Celina Cercado.","title":"4th Impact"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The group rose to popularity after competing in the 12th series of \"X Factor UK\", where they finished in fifth place.","title":"4th Impact"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" They are also known for having participated in several Philippine and international talent competitions, including the \"World Championships of Performing Arts\", where they won in 2006 and 2013, and the South Korean talent search \"Superstar K6\" in 2014, where they reached eighth place.","title":"4th Impact"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The sisters were originally from Santiago City, Isabela, but are now based in Metro Manila, Philippines.","title":"4th Impact"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Mosuo Sisters is a 2012 documentary film written and directed by Marlo Poras.","title":"The Mosuo Sisters"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It chronicles the lives of two sisters, Jua Ma and La Tsuo, who are members of one of the last matriarchal societies, the Mosuo tribe.","title":"The Mosuo Sisters"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Being an ethnic minority in China, the film explores their journey from working at a bar in Beijing to moving back home to their village in the Himalayas, dealing with the modern world impinging upon the traditional Mosuo culture and way of life.","title":"The Mosuo Sisters"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"are the documentaries Out of Place and The Mosuo Sisters by the same director ?"}
